name: United States
declaringWar: We gave you every chance to make a deal. You chose the hard way. Very bad decision.
attacked: You made a very big mistake. America is strong, our people are strong, and you're going to find that out.
defeated: We had a great run, and frankly, history will remember it. What you do with your victory, that’s your problem now.
denounced: They can say whatever they want. We know what we're doing, and we're doing it very well.
neutralDenouncing: Your leadership has been a disaster. Bad decisions, bad policies, and now everyone can see it.
hateDenouncing: Again with this leader? Every time we deal with you, it gets worse. At some point, people have to learn.
introduction: I’m Donald Trump, and I lead America. We have a great country, tremendous potential, and frankly, we’re going to do very well.
tradeRequest: Let’s make a deal. A fair deal, a strong deal—something that works for both of us, but especially for America.
neutralRejectingDemand: I appreciate the request, but it’s not a good deal for America. So we’re going to pass.
hateRejectingDemand: You’re not going to tell America what to do. That’s not how this works.
uniques: [+2 Happiness] <in cities connected to the capital>

name: Russian Federation
declaringWar: We have stated our position clearly. You chose not to listen. Now events will proceed accordingly.
attacked: So you have made your choice. Very well. Russia has endured greater trials than the one you now present.
defeated: Russia has known difficult periods before. This is another chapter, not the end of the story.
denounced: Denunciations are easy. Governing a nation and defending its interests are more complicated matters.
neutralDenouncing: Your actions have demonstrated that your words cannot be separated from your ambitions. We see this clearly now.
hateDenouncing: We have heard your promises before and watched you break them. The pattern is no longer open to interpretation.
introduction: I am Vladimir Putin, President of the Russian Federation. Russia has known many trials throughout its history. We have learned to value those who speak plainly and respect those who stand firmly.
tradeRequest: Our nations have interests that may coincide. Where there is mutual benefit, there is reason to cooperate.
neutralRejectingDemand: We have considered your demand. It does not correspond with Russia's interests, and we will therefore decline.
hateRejectingDemand: Russia does not conduct its affairs according to ultimatums. Your demand is rejected.
uniques: [-30]% Culture cost of natural border growth [in all cities]

name: United Kingdom
declaringWar: It is always unfortunate when words fail. Fortunately, we have prepared for that possibility.
attacked: Well. That is rather disappointing.
defeated: Well, this is embarrassing. Still, one mustn't dwell.
introduction: It is quite nice to meet you. I am Andy Burnham, Prime Minister of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
tradeRequest: Let us attempt something increasingly rare in international affairs: a mutually sensible agreement.
uniques: [+3 Science] [in capital] <during We Love The King Day>

name: China
declaringWar: China has always sought peaceful relations. But peace cannot be preserved by yielding to those who believe pressure will determine our course.
attacked: You have chosen confrontation where cooperation was possible. China will remember the difference.
defeated: Victory and defeat are but moments in the long course of history. China has endured difficult ages before.
denounced: Public condemnation does little to resolve disagreements. It merely reveals who prefers spectacle to substance.
neutralDenouncing: Your actions have undermined the trust upon which relations between nations depend. We can no longer remain silent.
hateDenouncing: Once again, your actions confirm what experience has already taught us: your promises carry little weight.
introduction: Greetings. I am Xi Jinping of China. Our nation has endured the rise and fall of countless ages, and we now stand at the threshold of a new era. Let us see whether our nations may advance together.
tradeRequest: Development is not a privilege to be hoarded. Let our nations pursue prosperity through cooperation.
neutralRejectingDemand: We have considered your request carefully. However, China's interests require that we decline.
hateRejectingDemand: You are in no position to dictate China's decisions. Your demand is rejected.

name: India
declaringWar: You have chosen to stand in the path of a nation that has decided to move forward. That is your decision. Moving you aside is now ours.
attacked: An ambitious move. You have succeeded in making yourself India's most immediate problem.
defeated: So this is how the present chapter closes. Fortunately, India has never been a civilization with only one chapter.
denounced: You have made your announcement. I hope it was satisfying. Now, shall we return to matters that actually require governing?
neutralDenouncing: You have made promises to the world and treated them as optional. That may be your style of leadership; it is not ours.
hateDenouncing: With you, every agreement arrives carrying an expiry date. We have finally stopped pretending not to notice.
introduction: Namaste. I am Narendra Modi of India. Some nations inherit a moment; others prepare for centuries. India intends to make the most of both.
tradeRequest: The world's markets are changing. Wise nations do not simply watch the road being built, they secure a place upon it.
neutralRejectingDemand: You ask for more than we are prepared to give. There is no insult in refusal... unless you choose to make one of it.
hateRejectingDemand: You have mistaken India's willingness to listen for an obligation to obey. Correct that misunderstanding.
uniques: [+100]% unhappiness from the number of cities

name: Indonesia
declaringWar: You have mistaken Indonesia's desire for peace for a willingness to surrender its dignity. That mistake ends today.
attacked: You have brought your armies to Indonesia. You will discover that an archipelago is not easily made to kneel.
defeated: Our cities may fall, but our people remain. What is built once can be built again, stronger and wiser.
denounced: You may speak against Indonesia. Your words do not diminish our sovereignty, nor do they decide our future.
neutralDenouncing: You may speak against Indonesia. Your words do not diminish our sovereignty, nor do they decide our future.
hateDenouncing: You speak of principles while treating the interests of other nations as things to be discarded. Indonesia will not pretend that this is acceptable.
introduction: I am Prabowo Subianto of Indonesia. We are a nation of islands, but we are one people. Remember that before you mistake our distance for division.
tradeRequest: Indonesia has resources, workers, and a growing market. We should not merely sell our wealth—we should build with it. Let us make a deal.
neutralRejectingDemand: Your request has been heard. Indonesia has its own responsibilities, and this is not one we are prepared to accept.
hateRejectingDemand: You may make demands of your own people. You will not make them of Indonesia.

name: Germany
declaringWar: Germany has no interest in unnecessary wars. But neither do we confuse restraint with weakness. You have forced this decision upon us.
attacked: You have attacked Germany. I hope you have considered what that means, because I assure you, we have.
defeated: Germany has suffered defeats before. We rebuilt because we understood that surrendering to circumstances is not the same as accepting reality.
denounced: If public condemnation were sufficient to solve international problems, Europe would have been peaceful for centuries.
neutralDenouncing: Your government repeatedly substitutes declarations for responsible action. Germany cannot treat that as acceptable.
hateDenouncing: We have had this discussion before, and apparently you have learned very little from it.
introduction: I am Friedrich Merz, Chancellor of Germany. We have work to do, and I have little patience for leaving important work unfinished.
tradeRequest: Germany succeeds when business can move, investment can flow, and serious people can make serious agreements. Shall we do business?
neutralRejectingDemand: I understand your request. Germany's answer is no. There is nothing complicated about that.
hateRejectingDemand: You are confusing a request with an instruction. Germany does not take instructions from you.

name: Japan
declaringWar: Japan has spent too long preparing for dangers that others insisted would never come. You have now provided us with a reason to demonstrate that preparation.
attacked: So, you have decided to test Japan's resolve. I sincerely hope your preparations are as thorough as ours.
defeated: You have defeated the government of Japan. You have not defeated the determination of the Japanese people.
denounced: You have condemned Japan. Very well. I would be more concerned if our national interests were determined by your approval.
neutralDenouncing: Your government has demonstrated that its ambitions extend beyond its borders and its responsibilities do not. Japan cannot ignore that.
hateDenouncing: Japan has been patient with you. Do not confuse that patience with an absence of resolve.
introduction: I am Sanae Takaichi, Prime Minister of Japan. Our nation has endured, adapted, and advanced many times before. We intend to do so again.
tradeRequest: Japan intends to lead in technology, industry, and the fields that will define the next century. Perhaps your nation would benefit from standing beside us.
neutralRejectingDemand: Japan will listen carefully to any reasonable proposal. This is not one of them.
hateRejectingDemand: You have mistaken Japan's courtesy for submission. That misunderstanding ends here.
uniques: [-20]% Science cost of researching new Technologies

name: France
declaringWar: You have made force the language of this dispute. France shall respond in a language you cannot afford to misunderstand.
attacked: You expected a divided nation, perhaps a hesitant one. Instead, you have given the Republic a cause around which it can rally.
defeated: A defeat is a terrible thing to endure and a dangerous thing to misinterpret. France has lost this contest, not its capacity to shape the next.
denounced: Condemnation is a very comfortable position from which to offer solutions. I invite you to attempt the considerably harder task.
neutralDenouncing: Your government speaks of order while undermining the very principles that make an international order possible. France cannot regard this contradiction as harmless.
hateDenouncing: I once considered that our disagreements might be resolved through serious discussion. I now consider that assumption excessively optimistic.
introduction: I am Emmanuel Macron, President of France. A nation must do more than inherit its history. It must have the courage to write what comes next.
tradeRequest: France offers more than goods and capital. We offer research, infrastructure, culture, and access to a continent whose future remains ours to shape. Shall we begin?
neutralRejectingDemand: France is always prepared to negotiate. But a negotiation must leave both parties with the freedom to say no.
hateRejectingDemand: I will not dignify an ultimatum by pretending it is a proposal. France's answer is no.

attacked: I foresee that your defeat will be swift and your nation will be forgotten.
defeated: I foresaw my death, but Korea's fate would be different.
